entries.title: Psalms 47:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

entries.title: Psalms 47:2
segments: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 47:3
segments: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:4
segments: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 47:5
segments: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:6
segments: Sing praise to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

entries.title: Psalms 47:7
segments: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 47:8
segments: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.

entries.title: Psalms 47:9
segments: The princes of the peoples are gathered together [To be] the people of the God of Abraham: For the shields of the earth belong unto God; He is greatly exalted.
